schemaPin: Exact report.DynamicFormSchemaHash equals form.PublishedSchemaHash, after existing family/version/snapshot validation.

table.identity: Exactly one table entry per definition tableId in a report. Identical names/configuration do not merge tables.

record.identity: Stable opaque nonblank recordId; never row position or a display label.

cell.missingCell: Not entered; distinct from an explicit null cell.
cell.number: Finite JSON number with <=17 significant decimal digits (excluding trailing zeroes), decimal scale <=28, integer magnitude <=9007199254740991. The decimal literal must equal the shortest round-trip Number/double representation; reject rounding and underflow instead of rewriting. UI accepts decimal or exponent notation and retains invalid raw input in error state.
cell.date: dd/MM/yyyy, MM/yyyy or yyyy; fullDate requires dd/MM/yyyy.
cell.maxLengthUnit: UTF-16 code units, matching .NET string.Length and JavaScript string.length.
cell.choice: Exact stored option code, never label or silently converted code.
cell.submit: Reject every error state and missing/blank required cell; preserve 0 and false as actual values.

write: Existing report full-draft payload revision/commandId; preserve legacy blocks and root metadata. Missing native envelope/table is not a delete command; records=[] explicitly clears a list table. A matrix keeps all defined rows with cells={} when unentered; required cells are enforced on submit.
read: Preserve raw on invalid JSON, unsupported version, pin mismatch or changed type; never initialize sample/default data during readback.
host: Manual WorkReportEditorPage mounts native tables by section; explicit full save/submit preserves legacy root blocks and native sidecar. Persist exact request/commandId before dispatch; acknowledged response is read back without another write. Aggregate/Flow and publish activation remain outside L4.
sectionProjection: Use pinned section.nativeTableIds to subset the native envelope. Native-only sections retain values, HasData/last-update/hash includes typed cell values/errors, and nativeTableCount is separate from legacy blockCount. Section detail adds nativeTablesVersion/nativeTablesJson only for native definitions. Never copy another section's native tables; Flow-restricted section detail is blocked until its native permission contract exists.

matrix.decision: D1 confirmed by Yud on 2026-09-16: one matrix value set per tableId per report; a Form may contain multiple independent Tables.
matrix.identity: reportId + tableId + rowId + fieldId, under the pinned schema. No instanceId or synthetic recordId.
matrix.rows: Exact set of the pinned table's row IDs, each once. Display order comes from definition rows; payload order does not change identity.
matrix.shape: Reject records, instanceId, unknown/duplicate/missing rows, foreign fields, and mixed record/matrix shapes. Never migrate a sample record during readback.
matrix.type: Resolve the highest-order column/row/cell rule for each addressed cell.
matrix.copy: A copied Table receives fresh table/row/field/statistic-target IDs; option codes and rule order stay unchanged. No join or statistic aggregation is inferred from matching labels or structure.
